title: Aspire Project: analysis code, frozen protocol, and execution logs for 'From Error Curves to an Estimated Weight'
description: Analysis code, the frozen analysis protocol with dated addenda (PREREGISTRATION.md), the verified bibliography, figure-generation scripts, and verbatim execution logs for the manuscript 'From Error Curves to an Estimated Weight: A Model-Based Reanalysis of Perspective Taking Across Adulthood.' The analyzed dataset is Bradford, Brunsdon & Ferguson's (2023) open data (https://osf.io/2epsu/), cited rather than redistributed; it is not contained in this archive.
